controles.affirmation: Le 4 mai 2026, Peter Arvan a cesse ses fonctions de PDG par accord mutuel avec effet immediat ; John Watwood, entre en janvier 2026 comme executive vice president, lui succede
controles.verbatim_source: On May 4, 2026, Pool Corporation ... and Peter D. Arvan mutually agreed that Mr. Arvan will cease to serve as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective May 4, 2026 ; Mr. Watwood, age 47, joined the Company as executive vice president in January 2026

controles.affirmation: Le depart d'Arvan a coute 8,3 M$ au T2 2026, dont 6,3 M$ de remuneration en actions non amortie et 2,0 M$ de couts de transition en cash
controles.verbatim_source: $8.3 million of CEO transition costs. CEO transition costs comprise $6.3 million of non-cash share-based compensation expense for awards previously granted but not fully amortized and $2.0 million of cash transition costs

controles.affirmation: Impact de 0,21 $ sur le BPA dilue GAAP ; BPA dilue de 5,17 $ identique a celui du T2 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings per diluted share was $5.17 in both periods. Adjusted earnings per diluted share increased 4% to $5.38 compared to $5.17 in 2025

controles.affirmation: CA du T2 2026 de 1 822,9 M$ contre 2 056 M$ au T2 2022, soit environ 11% de moins quatre ans plus tard
controles.verbatim_source: 1,822,938 (10-Q T2 2026) ; kpis-haut/POOL.json revenue_q : Q2-2022 = 2,06 Mds$, Q2-2026 = 1,82 Mds$
controles.correction_proposee: La precision affichee (2 056 M$) depasse celle de la source (2,06 Mds$).

controles.affirmation: Hausse de 2% du CA au T2 2026 dont environ 3 points venant de la seule inflation des couts produits
controles.verbatim_source: Net sales of $1.8 billion in the second quarter of 2026 increased 2% compared to the second quarter of 2025 ; a benefit of approximately 3% from inflationary product cost increases

controles.affirmation: Marge brute passee de 30,0% a 29,7% entre le T2 2025 et le T2 2026, du a des couts de fret entrant plus eleves et un mix client defavorable
controles.verbatim_source: Gross margin decreased 30 basis points to 29.7% from 30.0% in the same period of 2025, primarily due to elevated inbound freight costs and changes in customer mix

controles.affirmation: Resultat net GAAP -3% au T2 2026 (188,1 M$ contre 194,3 M$) et -3% au S1 (241,3 M$ contre 247,8 M$) ; seul le resultat ajuste progresse
controles.verbatim_source: Net income decreased 3% to $188.1 million from $194.3 million ; Adjusted net income increased 1% to $195.7 million ; 241,319 / 247,803 (etats consolides S1)

controles.affirmation: Dette totale de 1 340,7 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre 1 229,9 M$ un an plus tot (+9%) ; endettement moyen du trimestre passe de 1,1 a 1,3 Md$
controles.verbatim_source: 1,340,716 / 1,229,919 ; Our weighted average effective interest rate decreased to 4.2% in the second quarter of 2026 compared to 4.6% ... on average outstanding debt of $1.3 billion and $1.1 billion for the respective periods

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres de 1 260,0 M$ au 30 juin 2026, la dette totale represente plus de 100% des fonds propres
L'entreprise vise un ratio d'endettement cible entre 1,5x et 2,0x
controles.verbatim_source: repayment of debt to maintain an average total target leverage ratio (as defined below) between 1.5 and 2.0

controles.affirmation: Taux d'interet effectif moyen pondere de la facilite de credit de 3,9%
controles.verbatim_source: The weighted average effective interest rate for the Credit Facility as of June 30, 2026 was approximately 3.9%, excluding commitment fees and including the impact of our interest rate swaps

controles.affirmation: L'entreprise a continue de racheter 86,4 M$ d'actions au premier semestre 2026
controles.correction_proposee: Contexte omis : les rachats sont divises par deux sur un an (86,4 M$ contre 160,6 M$ au S1 2025), ce qui affaiblit l'argument de rachats poursuivis a credit.

controles.affirmation: Pentair, Zodiac Pool Systems et Hayward Holdings ont represente environ 43% du cout des produits vendus en 2025 (20%, 12% et 11%)
controles.verbatim_source: Our largest suppliers include Pentair plc, Zodiac Pool Systems, Inc. and Hayward Holdings, Inc., which accounted for approximately 20%, 12% and 11%, respectively, of the cost of products we sold in 2025

controles.affirmation: En 2025, 14% des ventes en construction neuve et 22% en renovation, soit environ 36% de discretionnaire contre 64% de maintenance non discretionnaire
controles.verbatim_source: 14% of sales stemmed from new pool construction ; we estimate that approximately 64% of our net sales are derived from maintenance and minor repair products, while approximately 22% of our sales are derived from products used to remodel, renovate, and upgrade pools

controles.affirmation: Le facteur de risque du 10-K cite explicitement les taux hypothecaires, la confiance des consommateurs et la faiblesse du marche du logement comme freins directs a la part discretionnaire
controles.verbatim_source: Discretionary consumer spending significantly affects our sales and is impacted by a variety of factors, including changes in general economic conditions, the housing market, unemployment rates, wage levels, interest rate fluctuations, inflation, disposable income levels, consumer confidence and access to credit (facteur de risque) ; In recent years, steady increases in home values, lack of affordable new homes and increased mortgage rates have positioned homeowners to stay in their homes longer and upgrade their home environments, including their backyards (section activite)
controles.correction_proposee: Le facteur de risque cite les 'interest rate fluctuations', pas les taux hypothecaires. La seule mention des taux hypothecaires figure dans la section activite et les presente comme un facteur FAVORABLE (les proprietaires restent chez eux et investissent dans leur jardin). Reformuler sur les termes exacts du facteur de risque : conditions economiques generales, marche du logement, taux d'interet, confiance des consommateurs, acces au credit.
